sum: A letter to a friend who is gone, told as a winter that will not turn into spring.
Love at first sight argued as physical law, as if the meeting were written into the body.
The love was real to him, and keeping it meant deleting himself.
He knows the sweetness is poison and drinks it anyway.
Self-love shouted back at critics, over pansori calls and samul nori drums.
After the stadiums, he wants the small facts of one person's ordinary day.
The pain of the life they chose, taken as the thing that keeps them breathing.
V's burnout ballad, where depression gets named as a colour.
Time kept moving through the pandemic without waiting for anyone.
Jungkook's solo: a happiness so complete he suspects it of being a dream.
Jimin's solo: being loved as something the universe arranged in advance.
V's solo: a voice buried under ice so that someone else could be loved.
Jin's solo: the person he was supposed to love turns out to be himself.
A plea for rescue from a cage that turns out to be on the inside.
A pep talk that says set the whole mess on fire and stop apologising for it.
Chasing a love he already knows he cannot keep, and refusing to stop.
He hates her and needs her, and cannot work out which one is worse.
A night-shift brag from kids who were told their whole generation had given up.
A victory lap aimed squarely at everyone who said they would fail.
A boy performing tough-guy swagger while visibly having no idea what he is doing.
A debut single that asks a Korean teenager what he wants, then refuses the answer.
A daydream about what one borrowed day with the person he cannot have would look like.
The first fan song: no promise of a perfect road, only a wish for more good days.
A door you build in your own head, and the shop behind it where the band talks you down.
The closing answer of the Love Yourself series: the person you were told to love is you.
He grows a flower that resembles her because he cannot let her see his real face.
Every lit window is a person, and the song counts seven billion of them as stars.
The fear of the day music stops moving him, which he calls his first death.
Burnout named as an illness, then treated out loud instead of hidden.
The day resets at midnight whether or not anything got better.
Two members sing the story of their own friendship, to each other.
A failure replayed so often it stops feeling familiar.
The small bird is told to try harder by the bird with longer legs.
Blowing the whole paycheque on purpose, because saving it changes nothing.
The best years are being claimed for the future, not the past.
